entities.name: Daniel, Count of Waldeck-Wildungen
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Daniel of Waldeck was a ruling count of Waldeck-Wildungen. He was the third, but eldest surviving son of the Count Philip IV (1493–1574) and his first wife, Margaret of East Frisia (1500–1537).
